orgScopeQuota.title: Organization Quotas
orgScopeQuota.hint: Token quotas aggregated by user / department / tenant; 0 means unlimited; enable the matching switch above first

hints.users: scopeId is the holder name (API key holder); usage aggregates across all that user's keys
hints.departments: scopeId is the department name; usage aggregates by the account's department
hints.tenants: scopeId is the tenant ID (product line / project group); only applies to non-default tenants bound to keys

orgScopeQuota.empty: No quota configured (this scope is unlimited)
orgScopeQuota.zeroMeansUnlimited: 0 means unlimited for that window; all zeros = record usage without enforcement
orgScopeQuota.saveFailed: Save failed, please try again later
orgScopeQuota.deleteFailed: Delete failed, please try again later
orgScopeQuota.deleteConfirm: Delete the quota for "{id}"? This scope will no longer be enforced.
orgScopeQuota.monthlyAmountHint: Limits the actual spend of the current month (enterprise amount ledger, effective for the current month); leave empty for unlimited.
orgScopeQuota.monthlyAmountUnavailable: Monthly amount limits require the enterprise edition (billing license) and are unavailable in this deployment; the window quotas above are unaffected.
